additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Michael,
I hope you are doing well.
During our initial analysis, we found that the session was aborted at 64% due to an internal communication issue within the charger. Following this, the charger repeatedly requested authorization to start a new session, as the truck remained connected.
However, these attempts failed because the user did not provide the required authorization.
We will investigate further and provide you with updates as soon as we have more information.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.

Hi,
The user went home because he was charging the truck overnight, therefore not able to make the autorisation after the session was aborted.
Can this be authorised remotely in the future.
Not sure whether the driver uses the RFID authorization or the AutoCharge process. You can check it in the name of the ID, truck number with "K" means RFID Card, Truck number without "K" means AutoCharge. (e.g. TG111111K vs. TG111111)
